name: CAS / name input
logic: User supplies CAS and/or name per chemical (F-HAZ-04)

name: Identity resolution
logic: Resolve CAS -> canonical name via an external identity service; Schedules contain NO CAS numbers, so name matching needs curated synonyms

name: Part II class (if not named)
logic: Derive from properties: flammable gas (bp <=20 C); highly flammable liquid (fp <21 C, bp >20 C); flammable liquid (fp <55 C under processing conditions); toxic/explosive classes per Sch 1

name: Property evidence
logic: flash point, boiling point, LD50/LC50, physical state (SDS)

name: Quantity
logic: max quantity present at any time (t)

name: 500 m aggregation
logic: same occupier installations within 500 m, pipelines, vehicles (R-061); Part II = total of class

name: Rule outcome
logic: compare aggregate with col 3 (MAH; r.4-9 incl. r.7 site notification) and col 4 (r.10-15 safety report etc.)
